en: A summary in new sentences that keeps the meaning.
ro: Naye jumlon mein khulasa jo matlab rakhta hai.

en: People and organizations answer for how an AI system works.
ro: AI system kaise chalta hai, is ke jawabdeh log aur idare hain.

en: Part of speech recognition that predicts phonemes from audio features.
ro: Speech recognition ka hissa jo audio features se phonemes batata hai.

en: A model with instructions and tools that acts to reach a goal.
ro: Model jis ke paas instructions aur tools hon aur jo maqsad ke liye kaam kare.

en: Python class that connects an app to a Foundry project.
ro: Python class jo app ko Foundry project se jorti hai.

en: Content Understanding configuration that says what to read and which fields to return.
ro: Content Understanding ki configuration: kya parhna hai aur kaunsi fields deni hain.

en: A secret string that gives access to a service; Entra ID is the safer choice.
ro: Khufiya string jo service tak rasai deti hai; Entra ID zyada mehfooz hai.

en: Word counts of a text without grammar and order.

en: Stateless API that takes a list of messages with roles.

en: A passage of a document that is embedded and indexed for RAG.

en: Field method that picks one value from a fixed list.

en: A number from 0 to 1 that says how sure the service is.

ro: Python class jo Content Understanding analyzers call karti hai.

en: Server-side history of one chat with an agent.

en: Checks whether related fields agree, for example items and total.

en: A speech model trained with your own audio or text.

en: Your own synthetic brand voice; limited access and speaker consent needed.
ro: Aap ki apni brand awaaz; limited access aur bolne wale ki ijazat chahiye.

en: A picture as Base64 text inside an address: data:image/jpeg;base64,…
ro: Address ke andar Base64 text mein tasveer: data:image/jpeg;base64,…

en: A Microsoft-defined area (EU, US or Asia Pacific) in which requests are processed.
ro: Microsoft ka tay shuda ilaqa (EU, US ya Asia Pacific) jis mein requests process hoti hain.

en: Transformer block that predicts the next token.
ro: Transformer ka block jo agla token batata hai.

en: Class that finds an identity: az login, managed identity and others.

en: A model made available under a name, with a type and capacity.
ro: Naam, type aur capacity ke saath dastyab model.

en: Separating a recording by speaker.
ro: Recording ko bolne walon ke hisaab se alag karna.

en: Python pairs of key and value in curly braces.

en: Microsoft service for identities, sign-in and tokens.
ro: Microsoft ki service: shanakht, sign-in aur tokens.

en: A setting outside the code, for example a key or an endpoint.
ro: Code se bahar ki setting, jaise key ya endpoint.

en: Measuring quality and safety of a model or agent over a dataset.
ro: Dataset par model ya agent ki quality aur safety naapna.

en: Field method that copies a value exactly as printed; documents only.
ro: Field method jo chhapi value bilkul waisi leta hai; sirf documents.

en: A summary made of existing sentences.
ro: Maujooda jumlon se bana khulasa.

en: Python text that inserts values in curly braces.
ro: Python text jo curly braces mein values rakhta hai.

en: A prompt that includes examples of input and output.
ro: Prompt jis mein input aur output ki misalein hon.

en: Agent tool that finds passages in uploaded files.

ro: Weights ki chhoti grid jo image par chalti hai.

en: Workspace for agents, files, evaluations and connections.

en: Field method that writes a new value, such as a summary.
ro: Field method jo nayi value likhta hai, jaise khulasa.

en: A written letter or group of letters.
ro: Likha hua harf ya huroof ka group.

en: How well an answer follows the given source.
ro: Jawab diye gaye source ke kitna mutabiq hai.

en: Giving a model trusted data to answer from.
ro: Model ko jawab ke liye qabil e bharosa data dena.

en: A named set of controls that detect and block risks.
ro: Controls ka set jo khatre pehchanta aur rokta hai.

en: Convincing but false output of a model.
ro: Model ka yaqeen dilane wala lekin ghalat output.

en: A person checks or approves what the AI does.
ro: Insan AI ke kaam ko check ya manzoor karta hai.

en: Keyword and vector search in one query.
ro: Ek query mein keyword aur vector search.

en: Using a trained model to get output.
ro: Train shuda model se output lena.

en: An attempt to make a model ignore its rules.
ro: Model se us ke usool tor wane ki koshish.

en: Azure service that stores keys and other secrets.
ro: Azure service jo keys aur doosre secrets rakhti hai.

en: Reduces a word to its dictionary form.
ro: Lafz ko us ki dictionary wali shakal mein lata hai.

en: An Azure identity for software, without a password.
ro: Software ki Azure identity, baghair password ke.

en: Marks the area of a picture that may be changed.
ro: Tasveer ka woh hissa jo badla ja sakta hai.

en: Numbers that describe the sound of a short audio frame.
ro: Numbers jo chhote audio frame ki awaaz bayan karte hain.

en: A model that works with several kinds of input, such as text and images.
ro: Model jo kai qisam ke input leta hai, jaise text aur images.

en: A sequence of n words that is treated as one unit.
ro: N alfaaz ki tarteeb jo ek unit samjhi jati hai.

en: Finding names, places, dates and their categories.
ro: Naam, jaghein, tareekhein aur un ki categories dhoondna.

en: Finding objects with bounding boxes.
ro: Objects ko bounding boxes ke saath dhoondna.

en: Reading printed or handwritten text in images.
ro: Images mein chhapa ya haath se likha text parhna.

en: Response header with the address to poll for the result.
ro: Response header jis mein nateeje ke liye poll karne ka pata hai.

en: Sentiment linked to targets such as food or service.
ro: Sentiment jo targets, jaise khana ya service, se juri ho.

en: The smallest unit of sound that distinguishes words.
ro: Awaaz ka sab se chhota unit jo alfaaz mein farq karta hai.

en: Special words that help speech recognition.
ro: Khaas alfaaz jo speech recognition ki madad karte hain.

en: Personally identifiable information, such as names and phone numbers.
ro: Zaati maloomat, jaise naam aur phone number.

en: Portal page for trying models, prompts and agents.
ro: Portal ka page jahan models, prompts aur agents azmaye jate hain.

en: Object of a long-running operation; result() waits for it.
ro: Lambe operation ka object; result() us ka intezar karta hai.

en: Tells a transformer where a token is in the sequence.
ro: Transformer ko batati hai ke token tarteeb mein kahan hai.

en: Hidden orders in data that try to change the behavior of a model.
ro: Data mein chhupe hukm jo model ka rawaiya badalna chahte hain.

en: Control that detects jailbreaks and hidden instructions.
ro: Control jo jailbreak aur chhupi hidayat pehchanta hai.

en: Pitch, duration, intensity and pauses of speech.
ro: Awaaz ki pitch, duration, intensity aur waqfay.

en: Reserved capacity (PTU) for steady traffic.
ro: Mustaqil traffic ke liye mukhtas capacity (PTU).

en: Tokens-per-minute limit of a subscription per region, model and type.
ro: Subscription ki tokens-per-minute had, region, model aur type ke hisaab se.

en: Retrieve passages, add them to the prompt, generate the answer.
ro: Hisse dhoondna, prompt mein dalna, jawab banana.

en: Low-delay audio conversation with a model.
ro: Model ke saath kam dair wali awaaz ki guftagu.

en: Model that thinks in steps before it answers.
ro: Model jo jawab se pehle qadam ba qadam sochta hai.

en: Targeted edit of an existing generated video.
ro: Bani hui video mein khaas tabdeeli.

en: Folder for related Azure resources.
ro: Mutaalliq Azure resources ka folder.

en: Newer API with input, instructions and output_text.
ro: Naya API: input, instructions aur output_text.

en: Shared access signature: limited access to a file in storage.
ro: Shared access signature: storage ki file tak mehdood rasai.

en: Add more instances of an app.
ro: App ke zyada instances chalana.

en: A label for every pixel.
ro: Har pixel ka label.

en: Labels text as positive, neutral, negative or mixed.
ro: Text ko positive, neutral, negative ya mixed label deta hai.

en: Straightens a scanned page before OCR.
ro: OCR se pehle scan shuda safha seedha karti hai.

en: Turns scores into probabilities, one per class.
ro: Scores ko probabilities banata hai, har class ki ek.

en: Video generation model in Foundry.
ro: Foundry mein video banane ka model.

en: XML that controls how synthesized speech sounds.
ro: XML jo banayi gayi awaaz ka andaz control karta hai.

en: Cuts word endings by rules.
ro: Usoolon se lafz ka aakhri hissa kaatti hai.

en: Frequent words with little meaning that are left out.
ro: Kam matlab wale aam alfaaz jo chhor diye jate hain.

en: Replies that always follow a JSON schema.
ro: Jawab jo hamesha JSON schema par chalte hain.

en: Billing container for Azure resources.
ro: Azure resources ka billing container.

en: Lasting instructions for a model.
ro: Model ke liye mustaqil hidayat.

en: Parameter for how varied the output is.
ro: Parameter jo tay karta hai output kitna mukhtalif ho.

en: The identity home of an organization in Microsoft cloud.
ro: Microsoft cloud mein idare ki identity ka ghar.

en: Graph algorithm for extractive summaries and key terms.
ro: Extractive khulase aur aham terms ka graph algorithm.

en: Score for terms that are frequent in one document and rare in others.
ro: Un terms ka score jo ek document mein zyada aur doosron mein kam hon.

en: Piece of text that models read, write and count.
ro: Text ka tukra jo models parhte, likhte aur ginte hain.

en: Architecture behind modern language models.
ro: Jadeed language models ka dhancha.

en: People know that AI is used, how it decides and its limits.
ro: Logon ko pata ho ke AI hai, kaise faisla karta hai aur us ki hadein.

en: Storage for file chunks and their embeddings.
ro: Files ke chunks aur un ke embeddings ki jagah.

en: Relates patches of an image with attention.
ro: Image ke patches ko attention se jorta hai.

en: Creates the audio waveform in speech synthesis.
ro: Speech synthesis mein audio waveform banata hai.

en: A prompt without examples.
ro: Baghair misal wala prompt.
